recognize_zh: 三顆嗜中性球都分葉不足：右上一顆為兩個圓葉以細絲相連的夾鼻眼鏡狀，左上與下方兩顆核呈腎形/C 形不分葉；它們的染色質都是成熟的粗塊狀，與帶狀核不同，符合假性 Pelger-Huët 變化。
features: One classic pince-nez bilobed nucleus with two round lobes joined by a thin strand
Two cells with unsegmented kidney- or C-shaped nuclei
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin in all cells
Background red cells with drying artifact; scattered platelets and small platelet clumps
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils with hyposegmented nuclei, including one bilobed pince-nez form and two cells with unsegmented kidney- or C-shaped nuclei. All show coarsely clumped mature chromatin and preserved granulation. Red cells show drying artifact only and platelets are present. The mature chromatin pattern despite reduced lobation distinguishes these from band forms; in the setting of infection-related leukocytosis, findings are consistent with reactive pseudo-Pelger-Huët change.

ddx.vs: Bands show a C-shaped nucleus of uniform width with finer, less condensed chromatin, whereas these unsegmented nuclei already have mature clumped chromatin.
The inherited form affects nearly all neutrophils persistently and is familial; morphology alone cannot distinguish it.
MDS typically adds hypogranulation, cytopenias and dysplasia of other lineages.
